borg.identity: Can only take worlds that are already inhabited; no research.

buildings.name: Assimilation Spire
buildings.effect: Converts natives or captured population into drones; +5 nanoprobes per cycle; combines assimilated tech into new tech.

buildings.name: Strip Harvester
buildings.effect: +60% yield; planet class degrades over time.

buildings.name: Collective Power Node
buildings.effect: Energy shared across every Borg colony.

buildings.name: None
buildings.effect: No research: assimilates tech from others and combines what the Collective holds into new tech.

buildings.name: Adaptive Shield Node
buildings.effect: Adapts to whatever weapon hits the colony.

buildings.name: Nanoprobe Beacon
buildings.effect: Speeds up turning natives into drones.
